verdictSaveFailed: Production Verdict could not be saved
superseded: Review stopped — repository moved to a newer commit
timedOut: Review timed out and was recovered
infrastructureUnavailable: Scan job infrastructure is not available
enqueueFailed: Could not enqueue Production Review worker
reuseCompleted: Review already completed for this commit — reusing existing results.
resumeActive: Review already in progress for this commit — resuming existing run.
